summary: bioAffinity Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a best-efforts public offering of 1,040,000 shares of common stock at $0.80/share and pre-funded warrants to purchase 2,960,000 shares at $0.793 each, generating approximately $3.2 million gross proceeds. The company engaged WallachBeth Capital LLC as placement agent, receiving a 7.5% fee plus $120,000 expense reimbursement. The securities purchase agreement includes a 30-day lock-up on equity issuance and a three-month restriction on variable-rate transactions. Proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a standard equity financing, not a special situation — no change of control, activist event, or strategic review occurs.
